newsitem.title: CROATIA: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly - August 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly - August 6.

text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian weekly Globus. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- British Foreign Minister Robin Cook, during his visit to Zagreb last week, had a fierce row with President Franjo Tudjman about the freedom of the media in Croatia, Globus learns from "informed sources".

- Stjepan Kljuic, member of the former Bosnian collective presidency and a moderate Bosnian Croat leader who was ousted by Tudjman early in the 1992-95 Bosnian war, claims in an interview the latest statements by Alija Izetbegovic, chairman of the country's current presidency, are aimed at supporting the ethnic division of Bosnia.

- U.N. amdinistrator of Eastern Slavonia Jacques Klein said Croatian Serbs from the region, due to revert to Zagreb control in January, will be transported to their former homes in Krajina by Croatian army trucks. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
